findings.evidence: grep `det_blockDiagonal` over ./mathlib/Mathlib returns only `det_blockDiagonal` (Determinant/Basic.lean:616); `blockTriangular_blockDiagonal'` is Block.lean:153; `Equiv.sigmaSubtype` is `@[simps]` at Logic/Equiv/Basic.lean:434-440.
findings.fix: Extract `Matrix.det_blockDiagonal' (M : ∀ i, Matrix (m i) (m i) R) : (blockDiagonal' M).det = ∏ i, (M i).det` as its own lemma (carrying the `LinearOrder` trick and a comment for why it is introduced), and prove the block identification from `Equiv.sigmaSubtype`'s generated simp lemmas rather than unfolding the definition. `det_piMap` then reduces to `rw [← det_toMatrix B, hmatrix, Matrix.det_blockDiagonal']; exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ det_toMatrix (b i) (f i)`. Likewise `hmatrix` is the reusable `toMatrix_piMap` (compare Mathlib's standalone `LinearMap.toMatrix_prodMap`, ToLin.lean:918).
findings.issue: `det_piMap` buries a general matrix fact — `(Matrix.blockDiagonal' M).det = ∏ i, (M i).det` — inside a linear-map lemma: lines 129-135 build an ad-hoc `LinearOrder ι` (no comment explaining that `BlockTriangular.det_fintype` needs it), apply `blockTriangular_blockDiagonal'`, and reindex each square block, closing with `simp [Matrix.toSquareBlock_def, Equiv.sigmaSubtype]` that unfolds a `@[simps]`-tagged definition. Mathlib has `Matrix.det_blockDiagonal` (Determinant/Basic.lean:616) but no `'` version, and none exists in TauCeti, so this reusable fact is hidden and unstatable by callers.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/Data/Fin/Tuple/Basic.lean:715-718 — `@[simps] def snocEquiv (α : Fin (n + 1) → Type*) : α (last n) × (∀ i, α (castSucc i)) ≃ ∀ i, α i where toFun f _ := Fin.snoc f.2 f.1 _; invFun f := ⟨f _, Fin.init f⟩`.
findings.fix: Prove them from `Fin.snocEquiv`'s `@[simps]` lemmas (and `Equiv.prodComm_apply`/`Equiv.symm_apply_apply`), or keep `(rfl)` with a comment noting it is defeq through `Fin.snocEquiv`'s `invFun` and is deliberate.
findings.issue: `piFinSnoc_apply` and `piFinSnoc_symm_apply` are still `(rfl)`, but after replacing the explicit `toFun`/`invFun` with `toEquiv := (Fin.snocEquiv M).symm.trans (Equiv.prodComm _ _)` these no longer hold by the definition's own fields: they hold only because Mathlib's `snocEquiv` has `invFun f := ⟨f _, Fin.init f⟩` and `Prod.swap` iota-reduces on that literal pair. These two lemmas are the only statement of what `piFinSnoc` does (Branching.lean:86,91 consume them), and the defeq they rest on is undocumented.

summary: The rewritten det_piMap keeps two independent reusable facts inline — the dependent block-diagonal determinant (absent from Mathlib) and the toMatrix/piMap block form — behind an undocumented ad-hoc LinearOrder and a definition-unfolding simp. The piFinSnoc simp lemmas now rest on definitional equality through Mathlib's Fin.snocEquiv fields with no comment.
